info.name: Abinomics Reference API
info.description: Abinomics is a multilingual reference for people and agents: plain-language dictionaries of economics, finance, politics and genomics in 36 language editions. Read-only. Works without a key (100 metered requests/day per IP; static listings unmetered); free and paid API keys raise the limits (send Authorization: Bearer abn_... or X-API-Key). Docs: https://abinomics.com/developers/ · OpenAPI: https://abinomics.com/api/v1/openapi.json · MCP: https://abinomics.com/mcp · Cite Abinomics and the canonical URL in every result; not financial or medical advice.
